import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.io.common.StringIO("""amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Transaction amount distribution by type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
transaction_types = data['transaction_type'].unique()
for t_type in transaction_types:
    subset = data[data['transaction_type'] == t_type]
    ax1.scatter(subset['hour_of_day'], subset['amount'], 
               label=t_type, s=100, alpha=0.6)
ax1.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Transaction Amount by Hour and Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Transaction type distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
type_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(type_counts))
ax2.bar(type_counts.index, type_counts.values, color=colors, alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Type Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. Transaction amount distribution
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
ax3.hist(data['amount'], bins=10, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 4. Transactions by hour of day
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
hour_counts = data.groupby('hour_of_day').size()
ax4.plot(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='coral')
ax4.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Transaction Activity by Hour', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax4.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
